ports.input: a 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.
ports.output: a 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.
a 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.
a 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.
a 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.
a 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.
a 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).

logic_description.description: Notice that below descriptions are along with tags <logic />. With a <logic type="combinational_logic" />, must construct this logic as interal wire declaration. Or this <logic type="combinational_logic" /> can be declared as a `reg` but only be used in always(*) block. With a <logic type="sequential_logic" />, must construct this logic as `reg` declaration. Must update this logic, in an always block, based on other <logic type="sequential_logic" /> or <logic type="combinational_logic" /> states. With a <logic type="sequential_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just place this operation sequence in below mentioned description. With a <logic type="combinational_logic_operation" />, no declaration for this keyword. Just based on the keyword `assign` to construct description of this combinational logic operation.
logic_description.logic: The output <logic refid="zero" /> flag is active if <logic refid="res" /> is all 0.

The output <logic refid="carry" /> is equalled to the MSB of the <logic refid="res" /> in cases <parameter refid="ADD" />, <parameter refid="ADDU" />, <parameter refid="SUB" /> , and <parameter refid="SUBU" /> alu opcodes. otherwise, <logic refid="carry" /> is 0.

In case <parameter refid="ADD" /> ALU opcode, the output <logic refid="overflow" /> is active if (MSB of <input refid="a" /> is deactive, MSB of <input refid="b" /> is deactive, and MSB of <logic refid="r" /> is active) or (MSB of <input refid="a" /> is active, MSB of <input refid="b" /> is active, and MSB of <logic refid="r" /> is deactive). In case <parameter refid="SUB" /> ALU opcode, <logic refid="overflow" /> is active if (MSB of <input refid="a" /> is active, MSB of <input refid="b" /> is deactive, and MSB of <logic refid="r" /> is deactive) or (MSB of <input refid="a" /> is deactive, MSB of <input refid="b" /> is also deactive, and MSB of <logic refid="r" /> is active). Otherwise, <logic refid="overflow" /> is 0.
The output <logic refid="r" /> is assigned to the first 32 bits of <logic refid="res" />.

The size of <logic refid="res" /> is 33 bits. <switch value="<input refid="aluc">"/> <case values="<parameter refid="SLL" />, <parameter refid="SRL" />, or <parameter refid="SRA" />" /> <logic refid="res" /> is result of appropriate shift operations between all 32-bit [0:31] <input refid="b" /> shifted by value of all 32-bit [0:31] <input refid="a" />, not just the first 5-bit of <input refid="a" />. </case> <case values="<parameter refid="SLLV" />, <parameter refid="SRLV" />, or <parameter refid="SRAV" />" /> <logic refid="res" /> is result of appropriate shift operations between 32-bit <input refid="b" /> and 5-bit <input refid="a" />. </case> <case values="<parameter refid="ADD" />, <parameter refid="ADDU" />, <parameter refid="SUB" />, <parameter refid="SUBU" />, <parameter refid="AND" />, <parameter refid="OR" />" />, <parameter refid="XOR" />" />, <parameter refid="NOR" />" />, <parameter refid="SLT" />" />, <parameter refid="SLTU" />" />, or <parameter refid="LUT" />" /> <logic refid="res" /> is the operation result normally from ADD, ADDU, SUB, SUBU, AND, OR, XOR, NOR, SLT, SLTU, and LUI. </case> </switch>
<logic refid="negative" /> is set to the MSB of the output <logic refid="r" />.

In case of <parameter refid="SLT" /> opcode, <logic refid="flag" /> is active if 32-bit signed <input refid="a" /> is less than 32-bit signed <input refid="b" />. In case of <parameter refid="SLTU" /> opcode, <logic refid="flag" /> is active if 32-bit unsigned <input refid="a" /> is less than 32-bit unsigned <input refid="b" />. Otherwise, <logic refid="flag" /> is set to 0.

module.implementation: The module uses parameters to define the control signals for various operations, such as ADD, SUB, AND, OR, etc. The module assigns the input operands to the signed wires and the output result <output refid="r" /> to the lower 32 bits [32:0] of the register <logic refid="res" />. The <logic refid="flag" /> output is determined based on the control signal <input refid="aluc" /> and is set to '1' when the operation is SLT or SLTU, and '0' otherwise. The <output refid="zero" /> output is set to '1' when the result is all zeros, and '0' otherwise. Inside the always block, a case statement is used to perform the appropriate operation based on the control signal <input refid="aluc" />. The result is assigned to the register <logic refid="res" /> accordingly. For the LUI operation, the upper 16 bits of <input refid="a" /> are concatenated with 16 zeros to form the result. If the control signal <input refid="aluc" /> does not match any defined operation, the result is assigned as '0'. Please provide correct `Logic description` fields above to achieve correctness for <module refid="alu" /> design in combinational logics.
